entries.reason: Measured in two warm sessions on Nebius AI Cloud (ml/appearance/evidence/generated-assets-session-1 and -2, 2026-10-07): the 80 items took 6.6 to 23.0 seconds with a median of 8.0, the slowest being each session's first; from the first starting state to the first batch took 596 and 608 seconds (the gpu-run records and done markers), after about 70 seconds of provisioning, so a cold start is stated as 680 seconds. The service's shortest timeout is one hour.
